pay.groups.description: How each group of employees is paid: how often, in which currency, when the tax year starts and when the inputs of a period close and the pay goes out. An employee is in one pay group at a time; the group changes through an employment change, not here.
pay.groups.help.code: A short code, unique in the company. It appears on the calendar and in reports.
pay.groups.help.currency: One currency for the whole group. Left empty, the company's currency is used.
pay.groups.help.startMonth: The month (1 to 12) in which the tax year starts. Enter it from the country pack; nothing is assumed here.
pay.groups.help.cutOff: Days before the last day of each period on which its inputs close (0 to 31).
pay.groups.help.payment: Days after the last day of each period on which the pay goes out (0 to 31).
pay.groups.help.threshold: A payroll run with a total above this amount needs a second approval.
pay.groups.activated: The pay group {group} was switched on.
pay.groups.deactivated: The pay group {group} was switched off.
pay.calendar.title: Payroll calendar
pay.calendar.description: Every pay period with the day its inputs close and the day it is paid. Open the readiness list of a period to see what is still missing before a run.
pay.calendar.year.help: The year in which the tax year starts. Leave empty for all years.
pay.calendar.denied: You may not see the payroll calendar.
pay.calendar.loadError: The payroll calendar could not be loaded.
pay.calendar.empty.generate: Generate the periods of a tax year for a pay group to see its calendar.
pay.calendar.empty.ask: Ask a payroll administrator to generate the periods of a tax year.
pay.calendar.more: Only the first periods are shown. Choose a pay group or a tax year to narrow the list.
pay.calendar.change.aria: Change the dates of period {period} of {group}
pay.generate.title: Generate pay periods
pay.generate.noGroups: There is no pay group that is switched on. Create one first.
pay.generate.year.help: The year in which the tax year starts.
pay.generate.weekday.help: The weekday on which each period starts. Needed for the first periods of a weekly or two-weekly group; later years continue from the last period.
pay.generate.explain: The periods follow the pay group's frequency, tax-year start month, cut-off days and payment days. A year that already has periods is not generated again.
pay.generate.error.fix: Choose a pay group and give the tax year.
pay.change.title: Dates of period {period} of {group}
pay.change.explain: The dates can change only until the period opens. The cut-off cannot be before the period starts and the payment cannot be before the cut-off.
pay.readiness.title: Readiness of period {period} of {group}
pay.readiness.denied: You may not see the readiness list.
pay.readiness.loadError: The readiness list could not be loaded.
pay.readiness.ready: Everything on the list is ready.
pay.readiness.notReady: Not ready: something is missing or cannot be checked yet.
pay.readiness.notAvailable: Cannot be checked yet. It comes with slice {slice}; until then it is never counted as ready.
